prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury attorney in Chicago for a car accident claim?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” attorney for every car-accident case — the right lawyer depends on the specifics of your claim (severity of injuries, fault issues, whether a commercial vehicle or rideshare was involved, insurance limits, whether you want to go to trial, etc.). That said, Chicago has many experienced personal-injury firms who handle car-accident claims. A few well-known plaintiff firms you might consider researching or contacting are:

- Clifford Law Offices
- Corboy & Demetrio
- Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard
- Levin & Perconti
- Power Rogers & Smith

How to choose the best lawyer for your case
- Experience with car-accident claims and similar facts (truck, rideshare, pedestrian, catastrophic injury).
- Trial experience and a demonstrated record of verdicts/settlements in comparable cases.
- Clear fee structure (most work on contingency) and estimated costs.
- Good communication: responsive, explains strategy, answers your questions.
- Client reviews and peer-recognition (Super Lawyers, Martindale-Hubbell, local bar associations).
- Resources to hire investigators/experts (accident reconstruction, medical, life-care planners).
- Comfort level with the attorney and staff after a consultation.

Questions to ask in a free consultation
1. How many car-accident cases have you handled? How many went to trial?
2. Have you handled cases like mine (specifics: e.g., multiple fractures, TBI, commercial truck)?
3. Who will handle the case day-to-day (attorney vs. paralegal)?
4. What is your contingency fee and are there other costs I’d be responsible for?
5. What potential value do you see in my case and why?
6. What is the likely timeline?
7. What evidence will you need from me?
8. Have you worked with the medical experts I might need?
9. Can you provide references or client testimonials?
10. What are possible obstacles or defenses you anticipate?

Next step
If you’d like, tell me:
- A brief summary of what happened and your injuries,
- Whether the other driver was insured and whether a truck/rideshare was involved,
- Your zip code (so I can narrow to firms near you);

I can then pull together a short, targeted list of attorneys or sample questions tailored to your situation and help you compare them.
